layout.signOutConfirm: Sign out of this app? Your groups stay; sign in again to see them.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in with your own Pryv account to use {{appName}}: join your group, invite patients for it and read their data under your own name.
signIn.notConfigured: This app is not configured: it names no Pryv platform. Set serviceInfoUrl in its settings, or open it with pryvServiceInfoUrl in the address.
signIn.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
signIn.waiting: Answer on the sign-in page. This page continues once you are signed in.
signIn.permissions: The app asks to read your messaging inbox (where a group's approval arrives; it also holds every consent your account has received) and to write in {{scope}} (your membership requests). It keeps your sign-in for this browser tab only.

groups.title: Your groups
groups.empty: You are not a member of any group yet. Ask to join one: an administrator of the group approves your request.
groups.unknownGroup: Group not recorded on this browser
groups.left: You left {{group}}. Its core removes the accesses it created for you on patients' accounts.
groups.trustNote: Each patient's data you open is read under an access that names you, recorded on the patient's account. Keep your Pryv account to yourself: Pryv records the account that acted, not the person at the keyboard.

join.title: Join a group
join.intro: Your request is written on your own account. You then show its QR code or link to an administrator of the group, who approves it and chooses your teams.
join.teamIds: Team streams on the group's account
join.teamIdsHint: One per line, for example :_cmc:apps:practice:team-a. Ask the group which teams to name.
join.displayName: Your name as the administrator sees it
join.displayNameHint: Shown on the request only. The membership itself names your Pryv account.
join.invalidTeams: Not a team stream: {{ids}}. A team stream looks like :_cmc:apps:{{app}}:<team>.
join.noGroup: Enter the group's username and host.

handoff.membershipIntro: Show this QR code to an administrator of the group: their phone opens the request in the group's account app, where they approve it. Or send them the link.
handoff.membershipIntroBare: Give this link to an administrator of the group: they paste it in the Group members page of the group's account app, or scan the QR code.
handoff.qrLabel: QR code of the membership request
handoff.capabilityNote: Whoever holds this link can answer the request: hand it to the group's administrators only. It works once and expires.
handoff.inviteIntro: Hand this to the patient, who answers with their own account. The patient's link is for a patient with an account on this platform; a patient on another platform pastes the request link in the consent page of their own account app. The invite works once.
handoff.inviteQrLabel: QR code of the patient invite

group.notFound: This group is not in your list. It may belong to another account.
group.waitingTitle: Hand your request to an administrator
group.noLink: This request has no link to hand over.
group.waiting: Waiting for an administrator to approve your request.
group.arriving: The group approved your request; your membership is on its way.

ended.revoked: This membership has ended. The accesses the group created for you on patients' accounts are removed.
ended.expired: This request expired before it was approved. Ask again if needed.

group.membershipGone: This membership is no longer valid: the group may have ended it. Refresh your groups.
group.noTeams: Your membership holds no team yet. Ask an administrator of the group.
group.invited: Invite created for this team. The patient's consent covers the group, and each member reads under their own name. Members of this team see each other's invites.
group.noPatients: No patient has accepted an invite in this team yet.
group.leaveIntro: Ends your membership. The group's core then removes every access it created for you on patients' accounts.
group.leaveConfirm: Leave {{group}}? You lose access to its patients.

patient.title: Patient
patient.noMembership: Open this patient from a group you are a member of.
patient.asking: Asking the group's core for your access to this patient…
patient.expired: Your access to this patient has expired.
patient.accessLine: You read this patient's data through team {{team}}, under your own access, until {{date}}.
patient.accessName: Access name on the patient's account:
patient.stamped: Each read is recorded on the patient's account under this access, which names you and the group.
patient.nameOnly: The patient's platform runs an older release: only the access name records who you are.
patient.noEvents: Nothing to show under this access.
patient.readOnly: Read-only view. Your access to this patient is kept in this page only and expires; nothing of it is stored.

errors.cmc-membership-permissions-invalid: The request names something that is not a team stream of the group.
errors.cmc-capability-invalid: There is nothing to leave: the group has not approved this request. It simply expires.
errors.cmc-capability-timeout: No answer yet. Try again later.
errors.cmc-member-access-not-member: The group's core does not recognise your membership for this request.
errors.cmc-member-access-relationship-not-found: The group has no relationship with this patient any more.
errors.cmc-member-access-scope-outside-membersh: This patient belongs to a team your membership does not cover.
errors.cmc-member-access-permissions-not-subset: The access asked for goes beyond what the patient granted.
errors.cmc-member-access-expiry-out-of-range: The group's core refuses this access duration. Ask the app's operator to change it.
errors.cmc-member-access-rate-limited: Too many requests for patients' data. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.cmc-member-access-in-flight: A request for this patient is already running. Try again in a moment.
errors.cmc-member-stamp-invalid: The patient's platform refused the access the group asked for.
errors.cmc-member-access-grant-not-delegable: This patient's consent does not let the group share the data with its members. Invite the patient again.
errors.cmc-member-access-peer-rejected: The patient's platform refused the access.
errors.cmc-member-access-peer-unreachable: The patient's platform cannot be reached right now. Try again shortly.
errors.cmc-member-access-membership-gone: Your membership ended while the access was being created.
errors.cmc-member-access-not-retryable: The request could not be completed. Ask again.
errors.cmc-member-channel-not-supported: Messages from a member to the group are not supported.
errors.cmc-member-access-unsupported: The group's platform does not support member accesses yet.
errors.cmc-member-access-token-missing: The access was created but did not reach this page. Ask again.
errors.cmc-offer-invalid-access-type: The group's platform refused the invite type.
errors.cmc-offer-invalid-permissions: The invite asks for permissions the platform refuses. Check the app's settings.
errors.cmc-offer-empty-permissions: The invite asks for nothing. Check the app's settings.
errors.invalid-access-token: This access is no longer valid.
errors.forbidden: This access does not allow that.
errors.unknown-referenced-resource: A stream this action needs does not exist on the account.
errors.invalid-parameters-format: The platform refused the request's format.
errors.sign-in-timeout: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
errors.sign-in-popup-blocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window.
errors.network: The platform cannot be reached. Check your connection.
